svg.title: Reading scanned pages
svg.desc: Scanned 310-page rose guide, characters extracted: c2m 203,577; Unsloth refused the upload because 37 pages needed OCR and its limit is 20; NeMo Curator 309 through its CPU text-layer path. Hangul characters on the 28 pages Unsloth sends to OCR: c2m 4,337, Unsloth 162 plus 4,164 Latin letters from English OCR, NeMo Curator 162.
